messages.author: edc894368bc2d98c
messages.subject: Unhandled Exception Error
parts:
Hi all,

When deploying shiny app with shinyapps::deployApp()
I keep getting the following messages:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 57708...DONE
Deploying bundle: 249784 for application: 57708 ...
Waiting for task: 71373815
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 71373817 error: Unhandled Exception: 

I already updated the libraries but it is still not working.

Thanks for the help in advance and best regards

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Unhandled Exception Error
parts:
Sorry about the trouble you are having. The issue is almost certainly an issue on shinyapps.io. I noticed that there were some transient errors that occurred yesterday at that time.  Are you able to deploy right now or are you blocked?

-Tareef
